title: Retrieval eval measures a lexical baseline, no-match and superseded cases
body:
Source: .krn/runs/research/sector-sweep-1119/report.md "S3 Retrieval".
Outcome: evals/retrieval gains a lexical whole-record BM25 baseline arm, no-match cases with a false-positive rate, and supersession cases (0 superseded records in top 5); the standards skill and `krn standards query --help` state the output shape (arXiv 2611.19123, 2611.20455, 2607.24882).
Proof: `node evals/retrieval/run.ts` prints recall@5 per arm including bm25, a no-match false-positive rate and stale-in-top5.
